constraints.name: jobs_semantic_schedule_pair_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (semantic_scope_id IS NULL AND semantic_period IS NULL OR semantic_scope_id IS NOT NULL AND semantic_period ~ '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}(:\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})?$'::text)

constraints.name: phase7_schedule_progress_bounds_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (required_through_period >= (first_policy_period - 1) AND retention_scheduled_through >= (first_policy_period - 1) AND retention_complete_through >= (first_policy_period - 1) AND aggregate_scheduled_through >= (first_policy_period - 1) AND aggregate_finished_through >= (first_policy_period - 1) AND last_complete_period >= (first_policy_period - 1) AND retention_complete_through <= retention_scheduled_through AND aggregate_scheduled_through <= retention_complete_through AND aggregate_finished_through <= aggregate_scheduled_through AND aggregate_finished_through <= retention_complete_through AND last_complete_period <= aggregate_finished_through AND last_complete_period <= aggregate_scheduled_through AND last_complete_period <= retention_complete_through)

indexes.name: jobs_policy_period_status_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX jobs_policy_period_status_idx ON operations.jobs USING btree (semantic_scope_id, semantic_period, job_type) INCLUDE (status, work_incomplete) WHERE ((semantic_scope_id IS NOT NULL) AND (job_type = ANY (ARRAY['measurement.daily-aggregate.v1'::text, 'measurement.detail-retention.v1'::text, 'measurement.aggregate-retention.v1'::text, 'measurement.withdrawal-cleanup.v1'::text, 'interaction.feedback-retention.v1'::text])))

indexes.name: jobs_semantic_schedule_once
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX jobs_semantic_schedule_once ON operations.jobs USING btree (semantic_scope_id, job_type, semantic_period) WHERE (semantic_scope_id IS NOT NULL)

indexes.name: phase7_schedule_progress_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX phase7_schedule_progress_pkey ON operations.phase7_schedule_progress USING btree (portfolio_id)

scope: All repository migrations on disposable native PostgreSQL; durable Portfolio/type/UTC-period deduplication under concurrent enqueue, independent-worker day-rollover retention barriers with held, retry-delayed, and dead keys, serialized Owner admission across a stale status snapshot and concurrent horizon advance, PostgreSQL-current-day horizon/admission fencing with a lagging worker clock, database-clock not-before enforcement for job and outbox retries plus a worker-clock-ahead UTC policy rollover, expired-before-reclaim job/outbox transition fencing with checkpoint resume, bounded contiguous catch-up and historical redrive, successful checkpoint retry-streak reset with fifth-failure/crash terminalization preserved, five existing versioned handlers, ten-job Owner assembly backlog reporting and restart, loopback Storage-adapter effects, truthful completion and coverage status, bounded indexed history queries, in-place upgrade row preservation, and legacy queue compatibility after application rollback. The #249 suites add protected GET/Bearer security, fixed host authority, bounded memory/time/claim controls, sanitized incomplete and dependency responses, Owner dependency failure propagation with durable retention and retry, overlapping authenticated triggers on the real queue, zero-claim Owner cleanup against an expired real PostgreSQL artifact, startup-budget accounting, exclusive gate-mode attestation, and Linux OS-SIGTERM qualification during compilation, worker startup, and a real PostgreSQL lock-barrier batch.
